facts.text: In the case of serious negligence, or poor risk management, your account might be closed at our discretion, and you will be expelled from the program.
Each individual position is capped at a realized profit of 5% of the stage profit target; INSTA withdrawals pay 80% of the profit target after a risk desk review.
